body.statement: For every \(n\) divisible by \(32\) in the exact late-ramp pair, the HT-centered interval of error radius \(13/32\) has coverage at least \(1-0.03794\) under both signs. A \(16\)-cell directed-rational compound-Poisson envelope certifies the sharper ramp-risk bound \(0.0379330711865835\).
body.justification: This exact finite calculation is the early kill test for atom handling, signed profiles, and threshold padding.
body.gap: No cited adaptive-inference paper supplies a reproducible directed-integer certificate for this atomic rare-arm ramp law.
body.consumer: The certificate is a regression test for the general convolution implementation before it is trusted on clinical logs.
